title: Human Checkpoint Decision Record (v1)
description: Append-only evidence artifact for one checkpoint decision. The recorded role is a declaration, never a verified identity; actor_class is the declaration the Gates enforce. The run_manifest.human_checkpoints row remains the control truth that gates read, and rows written before actor_class existed are read as human.

actor_class.description: Who the recorder says made this decision. A Gate that requires a human checkpoint only counts human rows; absent means human for records predating the field.

previous_decision_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the previous decision artifact file bytes in append order; absent for the first decision. Raises detectability of silent decision rewrites, not tamper resistance.
